title: Senior Forward Deployed Engineer (Tech Lead)
description:
Tabs is the AI Operating System for Revenue, built for modern finance and accounting teams. It combines deep revenue and accounting expertise with the agents and applications needed to run revenue work end to end. Tabs understands customer and contract context, applies accounting logic, and executes critical workflows with built in controls, auditability, and human oversight. With Tabs, finance teams can move from manually managing revenue workflows to directing outcomes while the system executes the work.


ABOUT THE ROLE

We're looking for a hands-on Technical Lead for our Forward Deployed Engineering (FDE) team that builds solutions for merchants whose needs go beyond what Tabs supports out of the box.

This isn't a traditional feature team. You'll work on real customer problems, often with messy requirements, unusual integrations, tight timelines, and no obvious solution. Sometimes the right answer is a quick, pragmatic fix. Sometimes it's a custom workflow or integration. And sometimes you'll discover a problem that deserves to be solved properly in the core product. Your job is to help the team make those calls, build great solutions, and ship them. Some of it will be scrappy, some will become core product, and telling the difference is part of the work.

This is a role for an engineer who likes shipping fast, enjoys ambiguity, and thrives on untangling hard problems to find durable, root-cause fixes.

You'll set the technical direction for the team while remaining hands-on in the code. You'll work closely with customer-facing teams, product, and the rest of engineering to turn ambiguous business problems into working software. You'll also help bridge the gap between customer solutions and the core platform: identifying what's worth reusing, what needs to be built properly, and what should stay a one-off.


HOW WE WORK

 - We move fast. Two-week sprints, weekly ship goals, short feedback cycles. We value working software over elaborate plans.

 - We get close to the problem. We talk to merchants, understand their workflows, and figure out what actually needs solving. Requirements aren't always going to arrive neatly packaged.

 - We work together. We're an NYC-based, in-office team that values collaboration, whiteboards, and solving hard problems together. Lunch and dinner in the office are on us.


WHAT YOU'LL DO

 - Lead technically. Set technical direction for the FDE team, make architectural decisions, review code, mentor engineers, and ship production software yourself. Be the technical point of contact between FDE and core engineering.

 - Turn messy problems into working solutions. Work with customer-facing teams to understand complex requirements, make sensible tradeoffs, and build custom workflows, integrations, and tools that deliver real value.

 - Lift up the rug. Identify problems that keep coming up across merchants and work with core engineering and product to turn the right solutions into reusable capabilities.

 - Own what you ship. From initial problem-solving through implementation, deployment, and production support.

 - Help build the team. Raise the engineering bar for the entire organization through mentorship, code reviews, technical standards, and hiring.

title: Staff Machine Learning Engineer, Evaluations
description:
At ASAPP, our mission is simple: deliver the best AI-powered customer experience—faster than anyone else. To achieve that, we’re guided by principles that shape how we think, build, and execute. We value customer obsession, purposeful speed, ownership, and a relentless focus on outcomes. ASAPP’s AI Engineering team is seeking an enterprising, talented and curious machine learning engineer.
 
The AI Engineering team is responsible for working closely with the research and modeling teams to create state-of-the-art NLP models for specific tasks, and deploy them in a production setting designed to serve our customers at scale. We are looking for a Machine Learning Engineer to help build and evaluate the core intelligence behind our agentic AI systems. This role will play a key part in designing and owning evaluation frameworks that ensure quality, safety, and performance across complex agentic systems.

We're looking for a Staff Machine Learning Engineer to own and grow the evaluation platform that measures quality, safety, and performance across ASAPP's agentic AI systems- the infrastructure that tells us, with confidence, whether a model or agent change is actually an improvement before it reaches customers.

This a hybrid role with 10-12 days of in-office presence per month to balance flexibility with collaboration.

What you'll do
 Lead the technical roadmap and architecture for the evaluation platform, from offline benchmarking to online/production monitoring of agentic and LLM-based systems.
 Design eval methodologies appropriate to different stages of the pipeline: golden/regression test sets, human-in-the-loop review workflows, LLM-as-judge approaches, and automated metrics for task success, safety, and hallucinations.
 Build the data infrastructure evaluation depends on: annotation and labeling pipelines, dataset versioning, data quality checks, and tooling that lets researchers and product teams run and interpret experiments without needing platform team help.
 Partner closely with Research, Product, and Platform teams to productize experiments into robust AI solutions
 Represent the eval platform to stakeholders outside the immediate team- set expectations on what "good" looks like for a model/agent release, and report on platform health and coverage.
 Stay current with advancements in ML, NLP, voice, and LLM systems, and contribute actively to technical discussions across teams.
 Mentor and support other engineers through design reviews, feedback, and knowledge sharing.
What you'll need
 Deep, hands-on experience building and operating evaluation systems for modern ML/LLM/agentic systems- not just consuming existing eval tools.
 Demonstrated experience leading the technical direction of a project or small team: setting architecture, driving design reviews, and being accountable for a system's long-term health (not just shipping features).
 Strong architectural skills, with proven experience designing complex, data-intensive software systems and production experience with Python, AWS, Kubernetes, and/or Docker.
 Experience designing data pipelines for ML evaluation- labeling/annotation workflows, dataset versioning and quality control, and reproducible benchmarking.
 A Bachelor’s Degree in CS or other related fields
 Demonstrated technical mentorship of junior and mid-level engineers, driving adoption of best practices and architectural alignment for scalability and extensibility.
